messages:
maya: quick design check — exploring a more compact streaming token readout for the playground. attaching a quick gif: https://img.redwood.dev/tmp/stream-token-gif (mock)
jon: nice! what's the goal? fewer pixels or less cognitive load? :eyes:
sam: +1 gif looks cleaner. are we collapsing the token counter to a pill when idle?
maya: yes — idea is collapsed pill on idle (token icon + short count), expands on hover/focus to full breakdown (prompt tokens / response tokens / cached prefixes). expansion should be instant, no heavy animation.
alisha: accessibility notes: if expanded on hover we must provide keyboard focus to trigger it, and announce changes with aria-live. hover-only is not acceptable. also contrast of the pill's text needs to meet 4.5:1 — current gray on light fails.
jon: makes sense. for the stop/regenerate controls — proposing a single compact control that toggles (stop while streaming, becomes regenerate after stop). Thoughts on discoverability?
maya: tradeoff: single toggle reduces clutter but users expect separate actions. suggestion: primary compact stop button + collapsed overflow with "regenerate" and "copy response". when stream finishes, primary becomes "regenerate" automatically.
sam: implementation note: the runtime emits `streaming.started` / `streaming.ended`. we can wire the button state off that. keyboard: map Escape to stop when stream active, and Cmd/Ctrl+R to regenerate (with confirmation when rate-limited).
ulx-snippet: ```html
<button aria-pressed="false" id="stream-toggle">● Stop</button>
<!-- when streaming: aria-live="polite" region for token updates -->
``` 
alisha: for aria-live — token updates are frequent; use `aria-live="polite"` and debounce to 400ms to avoid screen reader spam. when user hits stop/regenerate, announce "generation stopped" / "regenerating" with role=status.
jon: token counting: do we show exact tokens or rounded? product teams often prefer whole numbers to avoid noise.
maya: show exact for dev view (expanded), rounded for compact pill (e.g., 1.2k). clickable to expand to exact. add tooltip: "Exact token counts include system + prompt + response".
sam: also think about prefix cache indicator — tiny lightning bolt next to tokens when a cache hit reduces cost. backend will surface `cache_ratio` in response metadata.
maya: copy nits for prompt library: rename "My prompts" to "Saved prompts"? users confused between templates and saved chats.
jon: "Saved prompts" feels better and matches search UX. microcopy: add helper line under empty state: "Use the prompt drawer to save reusable prompts — they persist to your workspace." small and clear.
alisha: motion: prefer reduced motion for the expand/fade. respect OS `prefers-reduced-motion`.
maya: agree. last UX ask: show a subtle shimmer only on first 300ms of stream (to indicate typing), then switch to token-counters. avoids flash.
sam: will prototype with CSS variables. i'll also add telemetry hooks: `ui.token_pill_expand`, `ui.stop_clicked`, `ui.regen_clicked` for post-release tuning.
jon: timeline? can we get a small spec by EOD so eng can slot it into next sprint?
maya: i'll post a spec doc (short) by 5pm PST and attach updated comps. thanks all :heart: 
ux-bot: reminder — file an a11y ticket for contrast + keyboard focus before launch."
